notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Krenko.
description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod three times by sacrificing three Goblin tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
